thesis: SIBN is an uptrending small-cap medtech with stable double-digit revenue growth, a narrowing loss and a cash cushion that makes dilution unlikely. After a post-earnings gap to 25.92 it has pulled back in an orderly way to the SMA20, which gives a defined-risk entry (23.2-23.8, stop 22.55) with reward/risk of about 2.5 toward the 52-week high. A reimbursement tailwind narrative and the Dec 1 fireside chat are mild supports. The setup is only moderate: scores are +1 across the board, valuation is unknown, and the risk-off regime (QQQ below 50/200-day, VIX 31) argues for small size and strict adherence to the stop.
